items.title: AUDR by Chargebee
items.name: AUDR by Chargebee
items.summary: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
items.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.
top_comments:
@Chargebee pioneered the SaaS industry (first launched here in 2014), and so they do in the AI economy.

Agents call tools, hit APIs, even pay per request with products like pay.sh by @Solana Foundation. AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is the logical next step, and it's open. @Chargebee pushed the initial commit, adopted by @Mastra, @Merge, and more.

Star this repo: github.com/openaudr/audr

items.title: Figma Agent
items.name: Figma Agent
items.summary: Prompt, edit and prototype without leaving the canvas
items.description: Figma's agent lives right on the Design canvas and works with your real components, variables and team files, not flat images. Generate layout directions, bulk-edit across screens, turn comments into changes and build prototypes from a prompt. Pull context from Notion, Slack, GitHub and Linear via MCP, build your own plugins and shaders, and save repeatable workflows as skills your team runs with "/". Stay in flow from idea to review.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

Hunting this one because it's the first AI design tool I've seen that doesn't make you leave your real work behind.

Most AI design tools hand you a nice-looking image and then you rebuild it by hand in Figma. Figma's agent skips that step. It works inside your file, with your components, tokens and auto layout, so what it makes is something your team can actually ship.

What stood out to me:

💠 Explore directions fast - several layout options or a dark mode version, all built from your own design system
💠Kill the busywork - bulk edits, realistic copy and images, components applied at scale
💠Real context - paste a Figma file link, search the web, or pull in PRDs and research from Notion, Slack, GitHub or Linear
💠Build your own tools - ask the agent for a plugin or shader and it shows up in a new Tools tab
💠Skills - turn a workflow you repeat (a crit prep, an accessibility audit, a brand voice pass) into a skill anyone on the team runs with "/"

The real story is staying in flow, so no exports, no tool switching, no re-prompting from scratch every time.

What's the first repetitive task you'd hand off to it? 👇

congrats on the launch!!🚀

as a FE engineer side, how do i find out what changed? bulk editing twenty screens sounds great for the designer, but i'm the one who has to work out which of those actually need code.

right now thats me eyeballing the file against what's already shipped does the agent leave a trace of what it touched, or is it just a new version of the file.

"turn comments into changes" is the feature I'd actually want to stress-test before trusting it on a real team file. a single clear comment like "make this button bigger" is a fine instruction to automate. but a lot of design comments are proxies for an unresolved disagreement, a PM and an engineer leaving different comments on the same element because they want different things, and the discussion that's supposed to happen between those two comments is the actual work. if the agent just applies both literally, it can make the file look resolved when the disagreement never actually got talked through. does it flag comments that look like they're in tension with each other, or just execute whatever's attached to the component

items.title: Supademo AI Demo Agent
items.name: Supademo AI Demo Agent
items.summary: Agentic demos like your best salesperson, without the salary
items.description: Most AI demo agents feel like a video call where the other side isn't really listening. Silly animated avatar or obvious fake person on the other end. You ask a question, they keep talking. You try to navigate, but you're just watching their screen. Why bother? Supademo's AI Demo Agent is the opposite. Buyers click through real interactive demos hands-on, take any path, jump back, skip ahead. The agent listens, answers the actual question, surfaces the right proof. Voice or text, 50+ languages.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt! I’m Koushik Marka, co-founder of Supademo

For years, we’ve helped teams turn their products into interactive demos. But there’s a moment I kept coming back to:

A buyer finds you at 11pm. They click through your demo, get interested, and have a question.

“Will this work for a team like mine?”
“What does setup actually look like?”
“How would pricing work for us?”

Nobody’s there to answer. So they fill out a form and wait. Or they leave.

That’s why we built AI Demo Agents: a demo you can talk to.


By voice or chat, your agent:

🎯 Asks questions to understand what each buyer needs
🖥️ Brings up the right interactive demo, video, or doc during the conversation
✅ Qualifies buyers against your criteria and books meetings
🌍 Speaks your buyer’s language, around the clock

The part I’m proudest of: it doesn’t just talk about your product. It shows it.

You train it on what you already have: your demos, videos, docs, and website. You can then see what buyers asked and where the agent didn’t have a good answer, so you know what to improve.

We’ve made it fully self-serve, so you can set up an agent yourself without any engineering help. Your first 75 calls are free, with no subscription required.

Talk to our agent and try to stump it 👉

To everyone who tried early versions and told us exactly what was broken: thank you. And to our team: you built something I’d have called impossible two years ago. I’m so proud of you.

I’ll be here all day. Tell me what you’d want your agent to do, and where ours fell short. 🙏
agent that lets buyers click around instead of watching a bot talk, smart 🙌 do reps actually use it?

2024: Come to a website > interested > book a call > wait


2026: Come to a website > chat with an AI demo agent > see that it's a good fit > qualify yourself > routed to sales team or free trial > $$$$$

items.title: Supademo AI Demo Agent
items.name: Supademo AI Demo Agent
items.summary: Agentic demos like your best salesperson, without the salary
items.description: Most AI demo agents feel like a video call where the other side isn't really listening. Silly animated avatar or obvious fake person on the other end. You ask a question, they keep talking. You try to navigate, but you're just watching their screen. Why bother? Supademo's AI Demo Agent is the opposite. Buyers click through real interactive demos hands-on, take any path, jump back, skip ahead. The agent listens, answers the actual question, surfaces the right proof. Voice or text, 50+ languages.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt! I’m Koushik Marka, co-founder of Supademo

For years, we’ve helped teams turn their products into interactive demos. But there’s a moment I kept coming back to:

A buyer finds you at 11pm. They click through your demo, get interested, and have a question.

“Will this work for a team like mine?”
“What does setup actually look like?”
“How would pricing work for us?”

Nobody’s there to answer. So they fill out a form and wait. Or they leave.

That’s why we built AI Demo Agents: a demo you can talk to.


By voice or chat, your agent:

🎯 Asks questions to understand what each buyer needs
🖥️ Brings up the right interactive demo, video, or doc during the conversation
✅ Qualifies buyers against your criteria and books meetings
🌍 Speaks your buyer’s language, around the clock

The part I’m proudest of: it doesn’t just talk about your product. It shows it.

You train it on what you already have: your demos, videos, docs, and website. You can then see what buyers asked and where the agent didn’t have a good answer, so you know what to improve.

We’ve made it fully self-serve, so you can set up an agent yourself without any engineering help. Your first 75 calls are free, with no subscription required.

Talk to our agent and try to stump it 👉

To everyone who tried early versions and told us exactly what was broken: thank you. And to our team: you built something I’d have called impossible two years ago. I’m so proud of you.

I’ll be here all day. Tell me what you’d want your agent to do, and where ours fell short. 🙏
agent that lets buyers click around instead of watching a bot talk, smart 🙌 do reps actually use it?

2024: Come to a website > interested > book a call > wait


2026: Come to a website > chat with an AI demo agent > see that it's a good fit > qualify yourself > routed to sales team or free trial > $$$$$

high_potential_items.name: open-dots
high_potential_items.summary: Open-source, self-hosted AI agent workspace and alternative to OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot, Instinct, Manus Cue, Claude Cowork, and ChatGPT agent. MIT-licensed; includes chat, connectors, approvals, and optional computer use. Early prototype.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 自托管 agent 工作区，审批闸门内置
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把 OpenAI Dots、Manus Cue 这类云端 agent 产品的对话、连接器与审批机制拆成可自部署的一套，最值得借鉴的是把人工审批放在 agent 实际动手之前，而不是事后看日志。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先在一个自托管进程里跑通「对话 → 调连接器取数 → 人工点批准 → 才执行动作」，computer use 先不接，用两个只读连接器加一个写操作验证审批链路。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 464；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 开源自托管 AI Agent 工作台，含对话、连接器与审批流，可直接对标企业自动化与法律等垂直工作流场景，是今日最值得关注的产品化方向。

interest_sections.title: 企业自动化工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、Product Hunt，核心观察是需求已从“推荐自动化工具”转向“把跨工具环节串成可执行流程”，但现成解法仍卡在表格加协同平台的人工拼装，语音控制电脑这类交互尝试只在边缘出现。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户最明确的需求是把数据收集、审批流转、统计出图这类横跨多个工具的日常事务串成一条能自动跑通的流程，少靠手工搬运和来回催办

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现有讨论多停留在按场景罗列 Excel/WPS、企业微信/钉钉、SeaTable 这类表格与协同平台，再靠人工和制度把断点补齐，工业侧则因多家比价压价而把交付质量让位于价格。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把表格、审批、数据采集这些零散节点抽象成非技术员工可自行编排的流程层，并让每次自动化执行可回溯、可交接。

interest_sections.title: 简历优化助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，说明简历优化的真实卡点不在模板是否好看，而在经历合并时的合规表达，以及改完之后能否扛住面试官对同一段经历的反复追问。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者改简历的真任务是把自己多段跳槽经历合并倒叙、压缩进一页且排版不出错，同时保证写上去的每一条都能经得住面试官逐句深挖

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是两路并行——用职徒简历、五百丁、乔布简历这类网页工具做一键排版、一键导入旧简历和简历翻译（抱怨集中在导出环节被强制收费），或者付费找 1V1 导师代改；面对深挖则靠提前背熟项目流程图和业务逻辑硬扛。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把改简历这一步直接接到“这个岗位会从哪里追问、用什么材料回答”上，让简历版本和面试答辩共用同一份经历数据，而不是再做排版更花哨的模板工具。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是：当 46% 的代码由 AI 生成、面试官又拿不到候选人真实代码时，面试评估的缺口正从"考什么题"转向"如何在一小时内核验候选人自述经历的真实贡献"。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现在的做法一边是 take-home project 把候选人放进熟悉环境做小项目（但评分难标准化、对面试官要求极高），一边是求职者用 GitHub 上的 job-hunt-copilot 建个人项目素材库、自动生成定制简历和面试讲稿。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把"候选人自述经历"与可核验的产出痕迹（项目素材、AI 辅助下的真实提交）对上的对话式追问链路，让面试官能快速分辨个人贡献与团队贡献。

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是独居陪伴需求集中在日常对话与身体不适时的即时响应，现有做法仍靠自我消磨和有限家人互动，AI 陪伴产品开始用记忆与多 Agent 协作补连续对话。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 独居者在头疼脑热或阴雨天闭门不出时，最明确的需求是有人持续搭话并确认身体状态，而不是自己刷手机、看电视、摆弄花草

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论把解法放在自我消磨和与家人有一搭没一搭说话上，产品侧则用带认知记忆、多 Agent 协作的 AI 情感陪伴助手维持连续对话。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是让 AI 陪伴从被动等聊转向识别长时间沉默或不适表述后主动追问，并把异常状态同步给子女或照护者。
